info.title: AutoClipper AI API
info.description:
AI video clipping and YouTube publishing platform. Phase 0 contract.

Conventions: RFC 9457 problem+json errors with stable `code`; cursor pagination (limit ≤ 100); long-running operations return 202 + job_id and expose an SSE stream; mutating POSTs accept `Idempotency-Key`; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC, media positions are integer milliseconds with half-open intervals.

Cross-workspace access returns 404, never 403, to avoid existence leaks.

get.description: Dependency-aware: reports DB, Redis, storage and provider configuration status. Missing configuration is reported explicitly, never masked as OK.

post.description: Sets HttpOnly session cookie and returns a CSRF token for mutating requests.
Creates a project in SOURCE_VALIDATION. A YouTube source requires a rights declaration; if no authorized media source exists the response explains the situation and offers upload.

get.description: Actual metered usage; warns at 80% of budget and hard-stops at 100%.
Every value is database-backed. Empty workspace returns zeros plus an empty-state flag, never invented statistics.

RightsDeclaration.description: Recorded immutably in audit_logs. A YouTube URL alone is never treated as a grant.

ProjectUpdate.description: Changing settings never mutates the source file or existing clip versions.

Scores.description: Decomposed on purpose: technical quality is never folded into engagement.

ClipEditSettings.description: Declarative render inputs: trim, crop/layout, caption style+position, overlays, music, branding. Compiled to FFmpeg; never mutates source media.

QualityReport.description: Safety and copyright checks are risk indicators, not legal determinations.

PublishRequest.description: Requires a QA-passing clip version. Returns 409 clip_not_publishable otherwise.

insights.description: Only emitted when sample size is sufficient; states uncertainty.
